points.title: 童年与少年时期
points.description: 果戈理出生于乌克兰波尔塔瓦地区的一个小地主家庭，父亲是乌克兰小贵族，热爱戏剧和文学。果戈童年在乌克兰乡村度过，深受乌克兰民间文化影响，这为他后来的创作提供了丰富的素材。1821年，他进入涅仁高级科学中学学习，开始接触俄罗斯和欧洲文学。这段时期，他阅读了大量文学作品，包括莎士比亚、拜伦等人的作品，并开始尝试写作。1828年，他中学毕业，前往圣彼得堡寻求发展。
points.descriptionEn: Gogol was born in a small estate in Poltava, Ukraine, to a minor noble father who was fond of theater and literature. His childhood in the Ukrainian countryside exposed him to rich folk traditions that later influenced his works. In 1821, he entered the Nezhin Higher Scientific School where he began studying Russian and European literature. During this period, he read extensively, including works by Shakespeare and Byron, and started writing his own pieces. In 1828, after graduating, he moved to Saint Petersburg to pursue his career.

points.title: 文学起步与成名
points.description: 初到圣彼得堡的果戈生活困顿，做过小公务员和教师。1829年，他发表了第一部作品《汉斯·古谢加顿》，但反响平平。1831年，他结识了普希金，两人成为挚友，普希金对他的创作产生了深远影响。1834年，果戈理开始在圣彼得堡大学担任世界史副教授。1835年，他出版了《狄康卡近乡夜话》和《彼得堡故事集》，其中包括著名的《外套》和《鼻子》等作品，一举成名。这些作品以讽刺手法描绘了小人物的悲剧，奠定了他在俄国文学中的重要地位。
points.descriptionEn: Arriving in Saint Petersburg, Gogol faced financial difficulties and worked as a minor civil servant and teacher. In 1829, he published his first work, 'Hans Küchelgarten,' which received poor reviews. In 1831, he met Pushkin, who became his close friend and had a profound influence on his writing. In 1834, Gogol began teaching world history at Saint Petersburg University. In 1835, he published 'Evenings on a Farm near Dikanka' and 'Arabesques,' including famous stories like 'The Overcoat' and 'The Nose,' which brought him immediate fame. These works depicted the tragedies of ordinary people with satirical techniques, establishing his important position in Russian literature.

points.title: 文学遗产与影响
points.description: 果戈理的文学创作对俄国乃至世界文学产生了深远影响。他是俄国现实主义文学的奠基人之一，开创了'自然派'文学传统。他的讽刺手法和黑色幽默影响了后来的陀思妥耶夫斯基、契诃夫等文学大师。果戈理的作品将现实主义与幻想元素相结合，创造了独特的'果戈理式'风格。他的《死魂灵》被誉为俄国文学的巅峰之作，《钦差大臣》至今仍在世界舞台上广泛演出。果戈理的创作不仅影响了文学领域，还对俄国社会思想产生了重要影响，成为俄国民族意识觉醒的重要推动力量。
points.descriptionEn: Gogol's literary work had a profound impact on Russian and world literature. He is considered one of the founders of Russian realism and pioneered the 'Natural School' literary tradition. His satirical techniques and black humor influenced later masters like Dostoevsky and Chekhov. Gogol combined realism with fantastical elements, creating a unique 'Gogolesque' style. 'Dead Souls' is regarded as a pinnacle of Russian literature, and 'The Government Inspector' continues to be performed worldwide. His works not only influenced literature but also shaped Russian social thought, becoming an important force in the awakening of Russian national consciousness.

points.title: 欧洲游历与创作高峰
points.description: 1836年，果戈理的讽刺喜剧《钦差大臣》在圣彼得堡首演，引起巨大争议，因其尖锐讽刺俄国官僚制度而遭到官方批评。随后，果戈理开始长期旅居欧洲，主要在德国、瑞士和意大利。在罗马期间，他完成了代表作《死魂灵》第一部(1842年)，这部作品通过收购'死魂灵'的荒诞故事，深刻讽刺了俄国地主阶级和社会制度。1842年，他还出版了《与友人书简选》，表达了他的宗教和道德观念。这段时期是果戈理创作的黄金时期，他的作品风格日益成熟，思想深度不断增强。
points.descriptionEn: In 1836, Gogol's satirical comedy 'The Government Inspector' premiered in Saint Petersburg, causing controversy for its sharp criticism of the Russian bureaucracy. Subsequently, Gogol began extensive travels across Europe, mainly in Germany, Switzerland, and Italy. During his time in Rome, he completed his masterpiece 'Dead Souls' (1842), which satirized the Russian landed gentry and social system through the absurd story of purchasing 'dead souls.' In 1842, he also published 'Selected Passages from Correspondence with Friends,' expressing his religious and moral views. This period represented Gogol's creative peak, with his works growing in stylistic maturity and intellectual depth.

points.title: 晚年与精神危机
points.description: 1848年，果戈理回到莫斯科，并在此度过了生命的最后四年。此时的他经历了严重的宗教和精神危机，逐渐转向神秘主义和东正教思想。他开始焚烧自己的手稿，包括《死魂灵》第二部的部分内容。1852年，果戈理在莫斯科去世，年仅42岁。临终前，他经历了精神崩溃，拒绝进食，最终在宗教狂热中离世。他的晚年创作转向宗教主题，试图通过宗教救赎来拯救俄罗斯，但未能完成《死魂灵》第二部，成为俄国文学史上的巨大遗憾。
points.descriptionEn: In 1848, Gogol returned to Moscow, where he spent the last four years of his life. During this time, he experienced a severe religious and spiritual crisis, turning toward mysticism and Orthodox Christian beliefs. He began burning his manuscripts, including parts of the second volume of 'Dead Souls.' In 1852, Gogol died in Moscow at the age of 42. Before his death, he suffered a mental breakdown, refusing food and eventually passing away in a state of religious ecstasy. His later works shifted toward religious themes as he sought to save Russia through redemption, but he failed to complete the second volume of 'Dead Souls,' leaving a significant gap in Russian literary history.

appraisal.zh: 果戈理在俄国文学史上被公认为现实主义奠基者之一，他以讽刺与黑色幽默为小人物发声，揭露官僚腐败与社会不公，《死魂灵》《钦差大臣》兼具艺术价值与批判力量，并把民间文学与高雅文学熔铸为独特的民族风格，深刻影响后世作家。也有研究者指出，他早期创作倚重讽刺而少建设性方案，晚期转向宗教神秘主义，放弃了早年的批判立场，对官僚制度的揭露虽深却未提出有效改革，作品中还不乏对乌克兰与俄罗斯民族的刻板描绘。其精神危机与创作转向，使他成为艺术家与社会、宗教关系的典型案例。
appraisal.en: Gogol is widely recognized as a founder of Russian realism: through satire and black humor he gave voice to ordinary people and exposed bureaucratic corruption and social injustice, and Dead Souls and The Government Inspector combine artistic value with critical force, fusing folk and high literature into a distinctive national style that deeply influenced later writers. Researchers also note that his early work leaned on satire without constructive proposals, that his later turn to religious mysticism abandoned his earlier critical stance, that his exposure of bureaucracy, though profound, offered no effective reform, and that his works contain stereotyped portrayals of Ukrainian and Russian peoples. His spiritual crisis and creative shift make him a typical case of the artist's relation to society and religion.

supporter.zh: 果戈理被誉为俄国文学的天才，他的作品深刻揭示了俄国社会的矛盾与荒诞。作为现实主义文学的奠基人，他开创了俄国文学的'黄金时代'。果戈理通过讽刺手法和黑色幽默，为小人物发声，揭露官僚腐败和社会不公。他的《死魂灵》和《钦差大臣》等作品不仅具有极高的艺术价值，更成为俄国社会批判的经典。果戈理的创作将民间文学与高雅文学完美融合，创造了独特的民族文学风格，对后世作家产生了不可估量的影响。
supporter.en: Gogol is celebrated as a genius of Russian literature whose works profoundly revealed the contradictions and absurdities of Russian society. As a founder of literary realism, he initiated the 'Golden Age' of Russian literature. Through satire and black humor, Gogol gave voice to ordinary people, exposing bureaucratic corruption and social injustice. His works like 'Dead Souls' and 'The Government Inspector' possess not only high artistic value but have also become classics of social criticism. Gogol's fusion of folk and high literature created a unique national literary style that exerted immeasurable influence on subsequent writers.

critic.zh: 批评者认为果戈理的创作存在明显局限。他的早期作品过度依赖讽刺，缺乏建设性解决方案；晚年则陷入宗教神秘主义，放弃了早期的批判立场。果戈理对俄国官僚制度的批判虽然深刻，但未能提出有效的改革方案。此外，他的作品中存在对乌克兰和俄罗斯民族刻板印象的描绘，被指责为强化民族偏见。果戈理的精神危机和晚年创作转向，也被视为其思想深度不足的表现，未能持续保持早期创作的批判锋芒。
critic.en: Critics argue that Gogol's work had significant limitations. His early works relied excessively on satire without offering constructive solutions, while his later work descended into religious mysticism, abandoning his earlier critical stance. Although his critique of the Russian bureaucracy was profound, Gogol failed to propose effective reform measures. Additionally, his works contained stereotypical portrayals of Ukrainian and Russian peoples, accused of reinforcing national prejudices. Gogol's spiritual crisis and shift in later writing are also seen as manifestations of intellectual insufficiency, unable to maintain the critical edge of his early works.

objective.zh: 从历史与流行文化视角看，果戈理已成为俄国文学的重要象征。他的名字与'果戈理式'风格紧密相连，代表了一种将现实主义与荒诞、讽刺与悲剧相结合的独特文学手法。在文化领域，果戈理的形象被不断重塑，从严肃的文学大师到精神受苦的天才，反映了不同时代对俄国文化的解读。他的作品被改编成各种艺术形式，包括戏剧、电影和歌剧，持续影响着全球艺术创作。果戈理的生平本身也成为文化研究的对象，他的精神危机与创作历程被视为艺术家与社会、宗教关系的典型案例。
objective.en: From a historical and cultural perspective, Gogol has become an important symbol of Russian literature. His name is closely associated with the 'Gogolesque' style, representing a unique literary approach that combines realism with absurdity, and satire with tragedy. In popular culture, Gogol's image has been continuously reinterpreted—from a serious literary master to a suffering genius—reflecting different eras' understandings of Russian culture. His works have been adapted into various art forms, including theater, film, and opera, continuing to influence global artistic creation. Gogol's life itself has become an object of cultural study, with his spiritual crisis and creative process viewed as a typical case of the relationship between artists and society/religion.

self.zh: 俄罗斯的一切都是奇怪的，不可思议的。我们的俄罗斯生活不是在生活，而是在做梦。
self.en: Everything in Russia is strange, incomprehensible. Our Russian life is not life, but a dream.
